thought-record.title: Thought Record
use_when: A reaction feels bigger than the event
You are still stewing after a conflict
thought-record.leave_with: A balanced thought and a re-rated emotion

steps.1: What happened, as a camera would record it
steps.2: The raw thought in that moment
steps.3: Name the emotion and rate it 0–10
steps.5: What does not fit the thought
steps.6: A fuller view that holds both sets of evidence

exits.text: Accuracy check: if the thought is simply true, switch to “what would help?”

opposite-action.title: Opposite Action
use_when: You want to withdraw or lash out
The urge is bigger than the situation
not_when: The urge is about your safety
opposite-action.leave_with: One action in the other direction, done all the way

steps.1: As specific as you can: anger, fear, sadness, shame, guilt
steps.2: What the emotion wants you to do
steps.3: Does the urge fit the facts, not the feeling?
steps.4: A move in the other direction, all the way

exits.text: If the urge fits the facts, act on it skilfully instead

tipp.title: TIPP
not_when: Thoughts of suicide or self-harm — get help now
Cold water with a heart condition, beta blockers or an eating disorder
tipp.leave_with: A calmer body. The problem itself can wait.

steps.1: You need only one of the four. Paced breathing is the default.
steps.2: Temperature · Intense exercise · Paced breathing · Paired muscle relaxation
steps.3: The same 0–10 scale as at the start
steps.4: Stop here, or look at the cause later

exits.text: Still 7 or more after two skills: stop cycling, stay present

dear-man.title: DEAR MAN
use_when: You need to ask for something
A specific conversation is coming up
not_when: The other person is unsafe for you
You do not actually want this conversation
dear-man.leave_with: A short script in your own words

steps.1: One sentence: what you want, from whom, and what matters most
steps.4: Ask plainly, or say no plainly. No hints.
steps.5: What is in it for them, said honestly
steps.7: The script assembled in your words

exits.text: Optional: rehearse it, with the assistant playing the other person

wise-mind.title: Wise Mind
use_when: You are torn between two options
“I know what I should do, but…”
About to decide while very emotional
not_when: Facts you need are still missing
wise-mind.leave_with: An answer, a smaller step, or a time to ask again

steps.2: Let the feeling speak without editing
steps.4: A few slow breaths, then listen
steps.5: What you know when both are taken seriously
steps.6: Small and concrete, or a set time to return

chain-analysis.title: Chain Analysis
use_when: You skipped something you meant to do
not_when: Self-harm or suicidal behaviour — that belongs with a therapist
Something that was done to you
chain-analysis.leave_with: One to three places where the chain can break

steps.1: One instance: what, when, where, how much
steps.3: Sleep, food, illness, stress, an earlier upset
steps.4: Thought, feeling, sensation, action — step by step
steps.5: What it gave you right away, and what it cost later
steps.6: A specific alternative at each, plus prevention and repair

exits.text: For something you did not do: ask what got in the way at each point

behavioral-activation.title: Behavioral Activation
not_when: Your body needs recovery — plan rest
behavioral-activation.leave_with: One small activity with a day, a time and a place

steps.1: What you used to do and have stopped
steps.2: Is the low energy asking for recovery?
steps.3: An area that matters to you, not a “should”
steps.6: The likeliest obstacle, and one if-then plan

exits.text: If the body needs recovery, plan a deliberate rest instead
